Chapter II on one page

4Six kinds of punishment
5Government may commute a sentence
6Life imprisonment counted as 20 years for fractions
7Court picks rigorous, simple, or a mix
8Fine, and jail for not paying it
9One punishment where an offence is made of parts
10Doubt between offences: the lowest punishment
11Solitary confinement: the scale
12Solitary confinement: limits in execution
13Repeat offender: enhanced punishment
Section 4

Punishments

(a) Death
(b) Lifeimprisonment for life
(c) Imprisonmentrigorous (hard labour) or simple
(d) Forfeitureof property
(e) Fine
(f) Community servicenew; not in old s.53
  • Old s.53 IPC listed five; the Sanhita adds community service as the sixth
Bachan Singh v. State of Punjab1980verifyDeath only in the rarest of rare cases
Gopal Vinayak Godse v. State of Maharashtra1961verifyLife imprisonment means the whole of natural life
Section 5

Commutation of sentence

1Appropriate Government
2May commute any punishment, without the offender's consent
3As per s.474 BNSS
  • Central: death sentence, or offence on a Union subject · State: offence on a State subject, where the offender is sentenced
  • Replaces old ss.54, 55 and 55A IPC
Section 6

Fractions of terms of punishment

20 yearslife imprisonment, only for calculating fractions
Old s.57Sanhita adds “unless otherwise provided”
Section 7

Sentence wholly or partly rigorous or simple

Wholly rigorous
Wholly simple
Part and part
  • Applies where the offence carries imprisonment of either description · old s.60
Section 8

Fine and default of payment

Sub-s.RuleIPC
(1)No sum stated: unlimited, but not excessive63
(2)Court may order jail in default, over and above other jail64
(3)Offence with jail and fine: default term up to ¼ of the maximum65
(4)Default jail: any description allowed for the offence66
(5)Fine or community service only: simple, on a fixed scale67
(6)Ends when the fine is paid; part payment cuts it in proportion68–69
(7)Levy within 6 years; death does not free the property70
  • S.8(5) scale: fine ≤ ₹5,000 → 2 months · ≤ ₹10,000 → 4 months · any other case → 1 year
Shantilal v. State of M.P.2007verifyJail in default of fine is a penalty for non-payment, not a sentence
Section 9

Limit of punishment: offence made up of several offences

One punishment only, in three situations

✓Offence made of parts, each itself an offence
✓Act falls within two or more definitions
✓Several acts combine into a different offence
  • Fifty blows on Z = one beating, one punishment. A blow on Y who steps in = a separate punishment · old s.71
Section 10

Guilty of one of several offences, doubtful which

1Judgment: guilty of one of several specified offences
2Doubtful which one
3Punish for the offence with the lowest punishment · old s.72
Section 11

Solitary confinement

Term of imprisonmentSolitary
(a)Up to 6 months1 month
(b)Over 6 months, up to 1 year2 months
(c)Over 1 year3 months
  • Only where the Court can award rigorous imprisonment · never more than 3 months in the whole · old s.73
Section 12

Limit of solitary confinement

14 daysat a time, at most
Equal gapinterval not shorter than the spell
7 days a monthif imprisonment exceeds 3 months
Sunil Batra v. Delhi Administration1978verifySolitary confinement only under a court's sentence, not by jail authorities
Section 13

Enhanced punishment after previous conviction

1Earlier conviction by a court in India
2Under Chapter X or XVII, offence carrying 3 years or more
3Again a like offence under those Chapters
4Life, or up to 10 years · old s.75
  • Chapter X: coin, currency-notes and Government stamps · Chapter XVII: offences against property
Jail + fine offence · s.8(3)Fine or community service only · s.8(5)
Default term up to ¼ of the maximum2 months · 4 months · 1 year by amount
Rigorous or simple, as the offence allowsAlways simple

Do not mix these up

S.6 is only for fractions. Life imprisonment itself is not 20 years.

Solitary: 3 months is the total cap (s.11); 14 days is the cap for one spell (s.12).

S.13 counts only Chapters X and XVII, and only a conviction by a court in India.

Default jail under s.8(5) covers default of community service too.

20 वर्षआजीवन कारावास, केवल भिन्नों की गणना के लिए

दंडादेश पूर्णतः या भागतः कठिन या सादा

पूर्णतः कठिन
पूर्णतः सादा
कुछ कठिन, शेष सादा

धारा 8

जुर्माना और संदाय में व्यतिक्रम

उपधारानियमभा.दं.सं.
(1)रकम नहीं बताई: अमर्यादित, पर अत्यधिक नहीं63
(2)व्यतिक्रम पर कारावास, अन्य कारावास के अतिरिक्त64
(3)कारावास और जुर्माना दोनों: व्यतिक्रम अवधि अधिकतम के ¼ तक65
(4)व्यतिक्रम कारावास: अपराध के लिए अनुमत कोई भी भांति66
(5)केवल जुर्माना या सामुदायिक सेवा: सादा, नियत मापमान पर67
(6)जुर्माना चुकाते ही समाप्त; आंशिक संदाय पर अनुपात में कम68–69
(7)6 वर्ष के भीतर उद्ग्रहण; मृत्यु से संपत्ति मुक्त नहीं70
  • धारा 8(5) मापमान: जुर्माना ≤ ₹5,000 → 2 मास · ≤ ₹10,000 → 4 मास · अन्य मामला → 1 वर्ष
Shantilal v. State of M.P.2007जाँचेंजुर्माने के व्यतिक्रम का कारावास संदाय न करने की शास्ति है, दंडादेश नहीं
धारा 9

कई अपराधों से बने अपराध के दंड की सीमा

तीन स्थितियों में केवल एक दंड

✓अपराध भागों से बना, प्रत्येक भाग स्वयं अपराध
✓कार्य दो या अधिक परिभाषाओं में आता है
✓कई कार्य मिलकर भिन्न अपराध बनाते हैं
  • Z पर पचास प्रहार = एक पिटाई, एक दंड। बीच में आए Y पर प्रहार = पृथक दंड · पुरानी धारा 71

14 दिनएक बार में, अधिकतम

इन्हें न मिलाएँ

धारा 6 केवल भिन्नों के लिए है। आजीवन कारावास स्वयं 20 वर्ष नहीं।

धारा 8(5) का व्यतिक्रम कारावास सामुदायिक सेवा के व्यतिक्रम पर भी लागू।
